title: An empty address still exists
description: Sixteen persistent sockets distinguish selecting an address, toggling its Boolean and overwriting the grid with a checker rule.
limitation: A native port of the browser teaching study; its private cells do not control the museum floor. Height displays occupancy, not a third array index.

title: One class; whose state changes?
description: Two colour receivers read actual RefCounted Palette objects. Separate reference paths converge when both receivers share one instance.
limitation: Proposed Palette teaching class, with the browser's three inks and reset semantics; no claim that existing museum floor cells already use this class. Receivers refresh explicitly.
